title: Unittest discovery root-path guard
failure_signature: The closeout preflight counted one failed-import placeholder per module because the repository root was absent from the builder's module search path.
trigger_preconditions: A script under scripts loads repository test modules by dotted name.
Only the script directory is present on the interpreter module path.
candidate_workaround: Add the repository root to the builder module path before loading test names and reject implausibly small selected counts.
recurrence_guard: Inspect loaded identifiers and require the authorized selection to exceed the known inherited floor before staging.
rollback: Discard the nine-placeholder count, retain the candidate artifacts as superseded preflight output, and regenerate before canonical use.
scope_boundary: Test-name discovery only; no canonical test pass occurred.
